name: agent-fs-planned-units
body: `solution.component.agent-fs-tool-suite` —implemented-by→ `opencode-suite/tools/apg_rm.ts`, `opencode-suite/tools/apg_mv.ts`, `opencode-suite/tools/apg_cp.ts`, and its shared-plumbing anchor `opencode-suite/lib/apg.ts` (the shared plumbing the tools reuse and extend). `solution.component.agent-fs-install-registry` is anchored on the module `rust.apg.install`, where the `SUITE_TOOLS` `const` lives — an identity the code graph models at module level. Test-tier split (per `global.constraint.test-tier-boundaries`): the fs tools' executable path logic is real filesystem I/O, hence e2e, exercised against a scratch `/tmp` repo per the self-contained-e2e constraint; the acting-agent scope decision belongs in the `bun test` unit/int tier (`opencode-suite/lib/apg.test.ts`), exercised against a faked V2 tool context, side-effect-free. The self-enforcement path resolves the target against the caller's project directory and asserts the `edit` action through opencode's permission surface (`requirements.constraint.agent-fs-per-path-permission`), which decides in/out of scope.
